content: PostgreSQL native ENUM in Alembic: ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE cannot run inside a transaction block (and on PG<12 fails outright); the added value is unusable in the same transaction. Alembic's autocommit_block exists specifically for this. Values cannot be removed or reordered at all. A text column plus a CHECK constraint avoids all of it - a CHECK is altered by DROP/ADD CONSTRAINT inside an ordinary transactional migration.
